description: Webhook events Bridge could not deliver to your webhook URL (with the error). Bridge retries each one automatically for 24 hours (1m, 5m, 15m, 30m, 1h, 2h, 4h, 8h, then every 8h); auto_retry shows the next attempt, and final=true means the schedule ended and the event needs bridge_retry_webhooks. Use when incoming messages or statuses are missing in the CRM.
name: bridge_failed_webhooks
title: Webhooks that failed to reach your server
